title: Authorization Result
description: The result of an Auth authorization check. Every decision is auditable, and callers must treat an unavailable check as denied (fail closed).

allowed.description: Whether the actor may perform the requested action.

reason.description: Machine-readable decision reason. Implementations may add reasons; not_permitted, requires_approval, identity_inactive, and auth_unavailable are standard reasons.

requires_approval.description: True when policy permits the operation only after an approval flow. The architecture does not require approval by default.

actor.description: The identity evaluated by Auth, when available.

policy_ids.description: Policy records that contributed to the decision, when the provider can expose them.

audit_id.description: Stable identifier for the audit record of this decision.

correlation_id.description: The correlation ID copied from the authorization request.
